benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI-2
benchmarks.description_en: Novel abstract visual puzzles (semi-private eval set) from the ARC Prize Foundation; verified results only.
benchmarks.description_zh: ARC Prize 基金会的全新抽象视觉谜题（半私有评测集），只收录经官方验证的结果。

benchmarks.name: METR 50% Time Horizon
benchmarks.description_en: Length (in human-expert hours) of software tasks a model completes with 50% success, from METR's evaluations.
benchmarks.description_zh: METR 评测得出的、模型有 50% 成功率完成的软件任务长度（以人类专家小时计）。

benchmarks.name: OSWorld-Verified
benchmarks.description_en: 369 real computer-use tasks on Ubuntu/Windows/macOS; success rate of the best published agent configuration.
benchmarks.description_zh: 369 个跨 Ubuntu/Windows/macOS 的真实电脑操作任务，取最佳公开智能体配置的成功率。

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
benchmarks.description_en: Hard end-to-end tasks in a real terminal; scores depend on the agent harness (shown as scaffold).
benchmarks.description_zh: 在真实终端中完成的高难端到端任务；分数与智能体框架相关（以 scaffold 标注）。

benchmarks.name: LMArena Text (style control)
benchmarks.description_en: Crowd-sourced blind pairwise votes converted to an Arena score (Bradley-Terry), with style control.
benchmarks.description_zh: 众包盲测两两对比投票折算的 Arena 分数（Bradley-Terry），启用风格控制。

benchmarks.name: Aider Polyglot
benchmarks.description_en: 225 hard Exercism problems in 6 languages solved through the aider coding agent (pass rate after two attempts).
benchmarks.description_zh: 通过 aider 编程助手解 6 种语言的 225 道高难 Exercism 题（两次尝试后的通过率）。

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
benchmarks.description_en: 500 human-validated real GitHub issues. Epoch's fixed-scaffold run is authoritative; official leaderboard entries (any scaffold) shown as alternates.
benchmarks.description_zh: 500 个经人工核验的真实 GitHub issue。以 Epoch 固定脚手架复测为准，官方榜单（任意脚手架）作为备选记录展示。

benchmarks.name: LiveBench
benchmarks.description_en: Contamination-limited benchmark refreshed monthly; global average over reasoning, coding, math, data analysis, language and IF.
benchmarks.description_zh: 每月更新、限制数据污染的综合基准；取推理、编程、数学、数据分析、语言、指令遵循的全局平均。

benchmarks.name: FrontierMath (Tiers 1-3)
benchmarks.description_en: Unpublished research-level math problems, tiers 1-3 (v2 private set). Run by Epoch AI.
benchmarks.description_zh: 未公开的研究级数学题（1-3 级，v2 私有集），由 Epoch AI 运行。

benchmarks.name: FrontierMath Tier 4
benchmarks.description_en: The hardest FrontierMath tier - problems that take expert mathematicians days (v2). Run by Epoch AI.
benchmarks.description_zh: FrontierMath 最难的一级，专业数学家也需数天才能解出（v2），由 Epoch AI 运行。

benchmarks.name: OTIS Mock AIME 2024-2025
benchmarks.description_en: Mock AIME competition problems from OTIS; a contamination-resistant stand-in for AIME. Run by Epoch AI.
benchmarks.description_zh: OTIS 出品的模拟 AIME 竞赛题，可抵抗数据污染的 AIME 替代，由 Epoch AI 运行。

benchmarks.name: GPQA Diamond
benchmarks.description_en: 198 graduate-level, expert-written science questions that are "Google-proof". Independently re-run by Epoch AI.
benchmarks.description_zh: 198 道由领域专家编写、"搜索也难答"的研究生水平科学题，由 Epoch AI 独立复测。

benchmarks.name: Humanity's Last Exam
benchmarks.description_en: 2,500 expert-written frontier questions across 100+ subjects (CAIS & Scale AI). Text-only accuracy.
benchmarks.description_zh: 由 CAIS 与 Scale AI 组织、覆盖 100+ 学科的 2,500 道专家级前沿题目，取纯文本准确率。

benchmarks.name: SimpleQA Verified
benchmarks.description_en: 1,000 verified short-answer factuality questions; measures parametric knowledge without tools. Re-run by Epoch AI.
benchmarks.description_zh: 1,000 道经核验的短答事实性问题，衡量无工具时的参数化知识，由 Epoch AI 复测。

benchmarks.name: Vending-Bench 2
benchmarks.description_en: Final bank balance (USD) after running a simulated vending business for a year.
benchmarks.description_zh: 经营模拟自动售货生意一年后的最终账户余额（美元）。

models.name: Qwen3 235B A22B diff, no think, Alibaba API
